cut_gating.method: scripts/278 -- real official cut (R3 field-listing subset), not a simulated probability

method.forecast: Use all prior single-round total SG rows plus this tournament's own real R1 and R2 SG rows to estimate each real cutmaker's updated round-level SG mean and variance. Fix the real R1+R2 total; simulate R3+FR (2 remaining rounds) from negative simulated SG; rank among real cutmakers only -- the cut itself is never re-simulated.
